displayDescription: Navy curtains part on a moonlit screen; a rod puppet raises a lamp whose light throws a growing, connected network shadow.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (static translucent screen with seeded cloth grain)
SVG (ink-wash far layer, blurred cast-shadow network, rigged sharp puppet, hanging caption board, navy velvet proscenium)
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15 paused timeline tweening one state object; property setters redraw SVG synchronously (single owner per property)
audioDescription: Silent preview. No audio track, music, voice or sound effects were created.
limitations: Blender was not used, at the user's request. Shadow-theatre optics are approximated: a static Canvas 2D gradient stands in for a backlit translucent screen, SVG Gaussian blur stands in for penumbra, and a value-only radial hotspot stands in for lamp spill.
Shadow size scales with the node's distance from the held lamp, and shadows travel outward from it. This is an illustrative rule, not physically projected geometry.

STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes, so no reviewed recipe is demonstrated. The refresh instead applies the BACKGROUND_REVIEW source-frame lessons: a proscenium curtain wipe, a hanging sign whose text appears after it lands, value-stepped depth, lit cut-outs, and one warm accent kept for the light source.

The scene palette uses a moonlit silver-blue screen, near-black #12141C ink, a navy velvet proscenium and a single warm lamp accent #F4C26A. It replaces the earlier warm #EFE0BC example swatch under the scene_dependent background policy. The source's oxblood, amber, sunset subject and lettering were not copied.
The caption is readable from about 2.27 s to 3.0 s, a short hold that suits a 3-second style preview.

Typography uses the OS-bundled Gill Sans via @font-face local() declarations (no font file shipped). If it is absent on the render host, text falls back to Futura, Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Arial, then sans-serif.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent. The host runs QA.
